name: Vecna
slug: Vecna is an elder god of liches who watches from the periphery, pursuing hidden knowledge while reminding others they remain mortal.
description: Vecna is an elder god and the god of liches. He is associated with the gathering of powerful divine and supernatural beings, but maintains a somewhat detached presence, observing events from the periphery. He possesses significant knowledge and power, including an apparent interest in books and hidden knowledge. Vecna also recognizes the limits of mortal power, reminding others that even those granted extraordinary abilities and responsibilities remain mortal.

log.summary: During the ceremony, Vecna remains positioned around the outside of the dais before leaving the gathering to find a book. He later reminds the party that, despite the new powers and responsibilities they have gained, they are still mortal.
notes: Is positioned around the outside of the dais during the ceremony.
Leaves the gathering to find a book.
Reminds the party that despite their new powers and responsibilities, they remain mortal.

log.summary: Vecna is already waiting in the dragon roost from Emhet's vision, seated at a square slab table of crumbling maps and military-planning figurines, one of which hovers in his hand. The tapping stops as Walker reaches the door, and a faint humming stops seconds later. His face is sullen and white, with amusement under a vague smile, and he sits in a stone chair he dragged through the dust; of the three chairs, one is overturned and one is against the back wall. His hand and arm are an alchemical or mechanical replacement for a limb lost in a battle over an item the party reached first, which the DM compares to Walker's own. He expected Walker sooner and asks Walker to help retrieve his book. Walker refuses. The book is not identified.
